title: humanflops
blurb: a single-digit multiplication sprint — 30-second levels, tracking your answers per minute and accuracy — then a gentle comparison of your pace to a 1990 TI-81 graphing calculator and an RTX 3090. asked for by @shimmermathlabs.com, off the back of a thread about juniors, memorizing times tables, and what tools are for.
